notes.title: Dracula Frames is here. Play it now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38738670/9f9938518c0d3dd82d283d60ef538eebcb9c7b60.png[/img]

Dracula's castle consists of 8 floors. Each floor has a large picture with a magnificent painting representing landmarks of Dracula's life. Your goal is to rebuild each painting through a slide puzzle and get to the top floor!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38738670/e5ba4e946675bdf46733c767397b910e3ca9f007.png[/img]

The paintings are cut and shuffled in the jigsaw style, leaving the player to reposition the pieces.
The castle keeps secrets
Discover hidden items. Explore and discover secrets!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563530/Dracula_Frames/
